formulas.ascii: Edge cost, not the procedure: d_ij = sum over columns c of (z_ic - z_jc)^2, the squared Euclidean distance between standardized attribute rows, on each contiguity link. z = (x - mean) / s with s the population standard deviation (a constant column becomes 0). The tree T minimizes the total cost of a spanning forest; ties break on the lower-row CSR slot, so the forest is unique.
